title: Plant Quality Standard: Remakes and Who Pays (Factory Production Orders)
content:
**Standard.** Under Factory Production Orders, a remake rebuilds units of an order and its cause decides who pays. Factory defects (including units failing quality check), freight damage found by the branch within the delivery inspection window, and a Ridgeline mismeasure are company causes and carry no charge. Without a signed acknowledgment the specification was never confirmed and the remake is treated as a company mismeasure. An order that already carries the maximum number of remakes is escalated to factory engineering for the next one. Where partial shipment is allowed and at least the class minimum share of units has passed quality check, the passed units may ship ahead, but the order's ship date for lateness is still the date its last unit ships.

The delivery inspection window, the remake maximum, whether partial shipment is allowed and the minimum share are figures of the order's build class.

## Clauses no longer in force

1. Former wording, **no longer in force**: "A remake is charged to the customer only when its cause is customer specification error and the order acknowledgment was signed by the customer." The current wording of this condition reads: the condition that a remake is charged to the customer only when its cause is a customer specification error and the customer signed the order acknowledgment governs remake charges alone: neither an expedite fee nor a storage fee falls under it, and every remake charge remains under it.
2. Former wording, **no longer in force**: "A customer remake is charged at the class charge per unit times the units remade, on the remake date." A customer remake is still charged on the remake date; the amount follows the current basis for customer remake charges.
3. Former wording, **no longer in force**: "A remade unit is rebuilt within the class remake lead time from the remake date; a customer specification error remake that pushes the ship date is recorded as a delay notice with cause customer specification remake, and a company-cause remake that pushes it is recorded as factory capacity." A unit remade for a company cause is still rebuilt within the class remake lead time from the remake date, and a company-cause remake that pushes the ship date is still recorded as a delay notice with cause factory capacity; the rebuild lead and the delay notice of a customer specification remake follow the current basis for remake delay notices.

## Remake causes

| Remake cause | Company cause | Customer charge |
|---|---|---|
| factory defect (including a unit failing the factory quality check) | yes | none |
| freight damage found by the branch within the delivery inspection window | yes | none |
| company mismeasure (a Ridgeline mismeasure) | yes | none |
| customer specification error, acknowledgment signed by the customer | no | charged |
| customer specification error, acknowledgment never signed | treated as a company mismeasure | none |

The cause and the signature are read from the order's records — the remake's recorded cause and the acknowledgment signed checkpoint — not from the customer's account.

## Remake count and partial shipment

- The remakes an order carries are all of its remake records, of every cause, up to and including the one being handled. When the order already carries the class maximum, the next remake goes to factory engineering.
- Hypothetical example: on a 20-unit Custom Size Build order with a minimum share of 0.75, passed units may ship ahead once at least 15 units have passed quality check; the order's ship date for lateness remains the date its last unit ships.

superseded_clauses: A remake is charged to the customer only when its cause is customer_spec_error and the order acknowledgment was signed by the customer.

A remade unit is rebuilt within the class remake lead time from the remake date; a customer_spec_error remake that pushes the ship date is recorded as a delay notice with cause customer_spec_remake, and a company-cause remake that pushes it is recorded as factory_capacity.
A customer remake is charged at the class charge per unit times the units remade, on the remake date.
